accounting_policy.primary: Recorded injuries, forced movements, seizure, grants, ransom and commercial profit are distinct variables. No automatic monetary conversion across currencies/centuries. No net royal profit computed.

records.source_record: Heritage Ireland says approx 600 including women and children; Grey's original account reports 600 slain
records.count_method: one massacre; ~600 is approximate testimony not independent census

records.source_record: Cambridge peer-reviewed Hispaniola maroons study reports 25,000 ducats ransom. Spanish king's dated official letter confirms city robbed and ransomed without amount.
records.count_method: do not add to treasure seized or recognize amount as audited English state profit

records.quantifier: reported collected ransom in museum and English narrative
records.source_record: Cartagena historical museum and English narrative, accounting ledger or individual distribution not independently obtained
records.count_method: demand vs actual instalment and local treasury reimbursement require source audit; gross ransom not state net

records.quantifier: Spanish released captive account quoted by Quinn via Smithsonian
records.source_record: Spanish witness reported Drake took 300 Indians from Cartagena, mostly women
records.count_method: contemporaneous report, NOT identified persons list, NOT confirmed sold; witness-specific and alternative to others

records.unit: people described as Africans, Turks and Moors
records.quantifier: Spanish eyewitness claim quoted by Quinn
records.source_record: Same quoted report said some 200 Negroes, Turks and Moors
records.count_method: alternative descriptions overlap later records, NO addition with C10-M06/M07/M08

records.quantifier: Pedro Sanchez June 26 1586 deposition as quoted in academic publication
records.source_record: Reported 150 from Santo Domingo and Cape Verde, more from Santo Domingo
records.count_method: different witness, overlaps persons in M05; not an extra batch

records.quantifier: approximate Spanish deposition quoted by Young/Quinn
records.source_record: Reported around 200 Moorish galley captives from Cartagena and Santo Domingo allegedly promised repatriation
records.count_method: overlaps M05 and possible inconsistent fate; not proof of slave sale or emancipation

records.unit: Black people reportedly planned for Roanoke
records.quantifier: Spanish Havana dispatch reported conditional plan
records.source_record: Havana reported Drake intended to leave 250 at English Virginia colony
records.count_method: an INTENTION, NOT confirmed people settled or sold; alternative outcomes unknown

records.source_record: Jobson 1589 labels Rallegh seignory extending Youghal–Lismore at 40,000 acres
records.count_method: grant ≠ assessed cultivable acres, actual exclusive Crown occupation, or profit

records.quantifier: map describes Edmund Spenser Kilcolman grant
records.count_method: grant claim; figure differs from other summaries of Spenser's holdings, verify acreage type

records.quantifier: nineteenth-century editor, not independent original account
records.source_record: Intro to Robert Payne edition recounts 574628 claimed escheated post 1586 act
records.count_method: do not add to Raleigh and Spenser subsets; historical acres definitions/actual survey need checking

records.quantifier: archivally attested prize but no audited cost or market value
records.source_record: Mathes 1969 prints Pretty and Spanish testimony; data for specific cargo unexamined
records.count_method: no imputed 2.1million pesos from tertiary internet summaries; no GBP net

records.source_record: 25 September 1582 Edward Barkley military counsel, SP63/95/69
records.count_method: actual number of seized cattle/hostages unverified; no quantified policy benefit

records.source_record: Spanish reports say taken, some called rescued; no verified market sales accounts for this fleet
records.count_method: do not present transport as documented commercial sale, even if people enslaved in Spanish hands

records.source_record: Irish OPW official Carrigafoyle Castle history lists fifty Irish defenders
records.count_method: Do not assert 50 confirmed separately killed: some perished in collapsed wall, survivors executed; exact named fatality roll unavailable. Combined with M16 = sixty-six armed defenders before assault not deaths.

records.source_record: Irish OPW official Carrigafoyle Castle history lists sixteen Spanish allies among defenders
records.count_method: Combined 50+16 is a nominal defended force, NOT confirmed execution toll. Noncombatants unspecified.

records.unit: people claimed dead during six-month 1581–82 period
records.quantifier: St Leger contemporary estimate; McCormack 2004 peer reviewed treats as an upper-limit, independently unverified
records.source_record: TNA SP63/91/41 dated March12 and April20 1582 (as cited McCormack note77); reported famine/disease deaths in region not named-person census
records.count_method: Upper bound according to McCormack, NOT established true toll, no independent addition to war deaths or 1580 Smerwick; cannot allocate deaths proportionally by modern Munster counties.

records.quantifier: contemporaneous parish report / modern municipal texts have discrepant enumerations
records.source_record: Vigo government panel reports four days of plunder, destroyed buildings; exact house count excluded before checking 1589 parish-book transcript
records.count_method: Do not sum 270 vs 570 alternative estimates or use value as city-wide verified property destruction
